page_title: WOL 0-1 FRE | Wolfsburg v Freiburg 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) is penalised for a foul. Marco Fritz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+2' Merlin Rohl will be replaced by Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' He should have scored! Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
90' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
89' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Wolfsburg earn a corner.
88' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
88' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
87' That will be all from Lovro Majer who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg).
86' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Fritz had an easy-decision to make.
85' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) will miss the next game.
85' Booking. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) receives a caution from the referee.
85' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) is given a yellow card.
84' The attendance is 25000.
81' Marco Fritz blows his whistle for a foul after Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) hacks down one of his opponents. Wolfsburg have been awarded a free kick.
80' Substitution. Mattias Svanberg makes way for Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg).
80' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Yannick Gerhardt is replaced by Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg).
80' Substitution. Cedric Zesiger leaves the pitch and is replaced by Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg).
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.
79' The ball is out of play and Wolfsburg manage to earn a corner. Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
78' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
78' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
77' Marco Fritz shows a yellow card to Roland Sallai (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.
76' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
74' 0 - 1 GOAL! Kiliann Sildillia meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 0:1.
73' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
72' Total attempts – 8:3. 3:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
68' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) fails to convert a close-range free kick as he sends the ball narrowly over the bar.

67' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Marco Fritz stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Wolfsburg win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
65' The foul by Roland Sallai (Freiburg) was seen by Marco Fritz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
64' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
63' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) makes a slide tackle, but referee Marco Fritz blows for a foul. Wolfsburg will take a free kick near the side line.
60' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
58' Christian Streich has decided to substitute Vincenzo Grifo and he is replaced by Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
58' The substitution is prepared. Roland Sallai (Freiburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ritsu Doan.
57' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) receives a yellow card for infringement.
54' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) missed a big chance! He produces a stunning volley from inside the box, but his effort goes not far wide of the right post.
53' Freiburg are ruled offside.
50' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
50' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Fritz blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Wolfsburg.

46' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
46' Referee Marco Fritz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Freiburg as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
45' Referee Marco Fritz makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Freiburg. Let’s see what happens!
45' Surely that's handball by one of the Wolfsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
45' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

44' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play. Freiburg win a corner kick.
42' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
42' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
41' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
40' Wolfsburg are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
37' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar.
30' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the left side of the goal, but Noah Atubolu denies him.
28' A player from Freiburg brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Wolfsburg have a free kick from a promising distance.
27' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Koen Casteels, who smothers the ball.
25' 4:1 – the total goal attempt statistics. 1:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
24' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) rips an amazing volley from deep inside the box that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
20' The corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is cleared away by the defence.

20' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Wolfsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
19' Vincenzo Grifo plays a beautiful lofted pass to Matthias Ginter (Freiburg), who somehow crashes the ball miles over the bar from a promising position.
19' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
18' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Freiburg can continue in their attacking effort.
16' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) sends a long ball forward to Vincenzo Grifo, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
13' Ridle Baku nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
11' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
10' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.

8' So close! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
7' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) jumps into a tackle and Marco Fritz signals a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Freiburg.

6' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Noah Atubolu shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
4' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) wastes a huge chance as he sends a first-time shot from the goal area straight onto the crossbar!
3' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Noah Atubolu comes off his line to gather the ball.
1' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Marco Fritz is introduced as the referee for today's match.
